title: Finite local zero cover for an etale sheaf colimit section
statement: From a section whose image is zero in a filtered colimit sheaf on a quasi-compact etale object, extract a finite family of etale arrows with local eventual vanishing and the separatedness implication.

proof.text: Use sheafification local equality, openness of etale maps, and quasi-compactness to obtain a finite covering; record the induced local vanishing and separatedness properties.

mathlib_searches.query: finite cover filtered sheaf colimit eventual zero
IsFiltered finite cover sheaf section zero

lean.statement:
theorem etale_section_colimit_finite_zero_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ]
    (U : X.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left]
    (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max v w} Λ))
    (c : Cocone G) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I)
    (s : (G.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U))
    (hs : ((c.ι.app i).hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom s = 0) :
    ∃ (K : Type w) (_ : Finite K) (V : K → X.Etale) (q : ∀ k, V k ⟶ U),
      (∀ k, ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
        ((G.map f).hom.app (Opposite.op (V k))).hom
          (((G.obj i).obj.map (q k).op).hom s) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : I) (t : (G.obj j).obj.obj (Opposite.op U)),
        (∀ k, ((G.obj j).obj.map (q k).op).hom t = 0) → t = 0)
